ENT Case Pricer

CY2026 CMS PFS · NCCI PTP edits for every pair of these codes · pick what you did, see the credited work, the wording forks, and what the note must say

Reference only. Work RVU estimates from the published CMS national fee schedule, not a payment quote or a coding determination. Multi-procedure reduction, bilateral, and endoscopy-family rules follow the CMS indicators; payer contracts, local coverage rules, and modifier requirements differ. Where two code sets can describe the same operation the page shows the wording each one needs and says so — those are positions, not determinations. Verify every case against your own contracts and coding staff — the certified coder’s review is final. No patient information is entered, stored, or transmitted by this page; the case lives only in the URL.

Common case bundles (department-observed counts)

0.00work RVUs (est.)

Per surgeon: highest-valued procedure 100%, others 50%; endoscopy families pay the lead in full and the rest at the difference over the family base; add-ons exempt; bilateral ×1.5 where CMS allows -50. E/M codes are not reduced. Dollars are facility total RVU × the non-QPP conversion factor — surgeon-credited work, not a payment quote. NCCI edits apply within one surgeon, same date, same side; mark a co-surgeon's lines B and the edits between A and B lines are not applied.
